SUBJECT:
(Report on June 30 only) PRE-SELL
STYLE LOW PRICE - PROGRESS REPORT
EFFECTIVENESS OF: Transition Plan
Overall pre-sell efforts were successful. Retall accounts that previously stocked
Style Full Price accepted the introduction of the low price.
BIGIF / 2 FOR 1: Proved to be an excellent tool for pulling the balance of Style Full Price packs through the system. This aided the field greatly during the transition.
$7.00 CARTON COUPON/BUYDOWN:
Those situations were limited.
Effective in those retail calls that we could not exchange product out of.
